TARGET_AUDIENCE: Indian adventure travellers and friend pairs aged 24-34 who have saved scuba dive reels for months, booked dive slots and ferry transfers, but struggle with tracking shared gear rentals, boat charter costs, and offline medical waivers across the trip.
PAIN_POINT: Between private jetty transfers, dive school equipment deposits, boat fuel surcharges, and scattered digital medical waivers, one person inevitably foots the bill on spotty island 4G while expense logs get buried in chaotic WhatsApp threads.
DESTINATION: Havelock Island (Swaraj Dweep) and Neil Island, Andaman and Nicobar Islands
CREATIVE_ANGLE: They are ready to dive Nemo Reef and Dixon's Pinnacle, but nobody knows who paid for the shared underwater camera rig versus the morning boat charter, and vital medical clearance forms are buried somewhere in a 500-message chat. Travafa's Shared Coordination centralises gear checklists, emergency dive docs, and automatic expense balancing in one place, instantly splitting shared boat costs and keeping everyone squared away before hitting the water.
LOOK_CONSTRAINTS: time_of_day: overcast sky, soft diffuse light, no hard shadows; weather: strong wind moving fabric, hair and foliage; palette: high-contrast saturated tropical greens and blues; film_look: clean modern digital capture, sharp; human_presence: two travellers together, friends or partners
HOOK_STYLE: the scene opens on dialogue already in progress between two people, and the camera finds them
PACING_SHAPE: give the problem and escalation more room; compress the product demonstration into a single fast, confident beat
ENDING_STYLE: the final part is a silent environment shot with no one in frame; the CTA overlay lands on it
DIALOGUE_DENSITY: keep dialogue-carrying blocks distributed roughly evenly through the parts that carry dialogue
CharacterStyle: Two friends in their late 20s; one wearing a quick-dry sage green technical rashguard, dark charcoal board shorts, and a matte black dive watch; the other wearing a wind-blown unbuttoned navy linen shirt over a white ribbed tank top, olive utility shorts, and round tortoiseshell sunglasses hooked on the collar.
Setting: A weathered wooden jetty on Havelock Island lined with stacked yellow scuba tanks and hanging black neoprene dive suits, overlooking choppy turquoise water and wind-swept palm trees under an overcast coastal sky.
ReferenceTone: Sharp, clean modern digital capture with saturated ocean cyans and lush jungle greens, soft diffused natural daylight without harsh shadows, candid and wind-blown outdoor documentary realism.
PhoneShotAction: The screen itself is the beat - held steady and angled directly to the camera against the dock, displaying Travafa's Shared Coordination screen as a finger taps to confirm a shared dive charter expense and settle balances across the group.
